title: Accession
description: Capture a succession controller without destroying its chain of custody.
objective: Recover evidence at Authoritative record / Capture controller at Response controller
condition: All required objectives must be secured. Optional archives pay extra. Quiet bonus uses peak trace.
aftermath: The controller recognizes a vacant seat that has been empty for eleven years.

lore.title: Accession / Unsent message
lore.text: ORIN / Directorate defector: Capture a succession controller without destroying its chain of custody. The sender asks you to keep the names attached to the evidence; anonymous totals have concealed people before.

lore.title: Accession / Custody note
lore.text: Archive custody, Accession: The controller recognizes a vacant seat that has been empty for eleven years. A second copy carries a hand-written objection to the official disposition.

lore.title: Accession / Private annotation
lore.text: Personal note filed under accession: The controller recognizes a vacant seat that has been empty for eleven years. Someone has crossed out the word inevitable. No replacement was supplied.

revelation: The controller recognizes a vacant seat that has been empty for eleven years.
